corpus.en: I read the book (all of it).
We live in a big house.
Without water there is no life.
I have a lot of friends.

corpus.ru: Мы с дру́гом игра́ем в волейбо́л.
corpus.en: My friend and I play volleyball.
We are going to another city.
I'm writing a letter to my brother.
The little cats are at home.
I don't have a big house.
I'm playing with my little brother.
I'm reading with my little sister.
I'm thinking about the new city.
The book is in the new car.
There are four books on the table.
I get up at six o'clock.
There are seven days in a week.
I have a lesson at eight.
How old are you? (to a friend)
There are ten books on the table.
Where are you from? (to a friend)
Excuse me, where is the metro?

corpus.ru: Я студе́нт. Я учу́сь в университе́те.
corpus.en: I'm a student. I study at university.
Where is my phone? — It's here.
Where is the book? — It's on the table.
Where is the letter? — It's here.
Where are they? — They are at home.

corpus.ru: У тебя́ есть телефо́н? — Да, есть.
corpus.en: Do you have a phone? — Yes, I do.
Do you have a car? — No.
I call my mum every day.
My grandma lives in the city.

corpus.ru: У меня́ два бра́та и одна́ сестра́.
corpus.en: I have two brothers and one sister.
How many brothers do you have?
My brother works at a bank.
Tell me please, where is the metro?
Do you know where the pharmacy is?
What time is it? — It's three o'clock.
The lesson is at five o'clock.

corpus.ru: Я рабо́таю во́семь часо́в в день.
corpus.en: I work eight hours a day.
In the morning I drink coffee.
On Monday I have a lesson.

corpus.ru: В четве́рг мы игра́ем в волейбо́л.
В пя́тницу я иду́ в мече́ть.
corpus.en: On Friday I go to the mosque.

corpus.ru: В суббо́ту я сплю до десяти́.
corpus.en: On Saturday I sleep until ten.
On Sunday the shop is closed.
The film is at seven o'clock.
What do you eat for breakfast?
What will you have to drink?
The milk is in the fridge.
Today's soup of the day is borscht.

corpus.ru: Я ем одно́ я́блоко в день.
corpus.en: I eat one apple a day.

corpus.ru: Суп с мя́сом и́ли с ры́бой?
corpus.en: Soup with meat or with fish?
Excuse me, where is the toilet here?
The shop is open until ten.
I need to go to the bank.
How do I get to the station?
Fruit is cheap at the market.
We are walking in the park.
The mosque is on Brīvības Street.
On Friday I'm at the mosque.
The pharmacy is on the left, the bank on the right.
Is it far? — No, very close.
Tomorrow I'll go to the bank.
In summer we'll go to Libya.
There are many trams in Riga.

corpus.ru: По́езд в Та́ллин в во́семь часо́в.
corpus.en: The train to Tallinn is at eight.
Where are you? — In the park.
Where are you going? — To the park.

corpus.ru: Мы е́дем на авто́бусе на ры́нок.
corpus.en: We're going by bus to the market.
She thought it over and said “yes”.
Have you seen my phone? (to a man)
I saw him in the park. (a woman speaking)

corpus.ru: Я прие́хал в Ри́гу три ме́сяца наза́д.
corpus.en: I came to Riga three months ago.
I used to live in Libya.

corpus.ru: Я чита́л кни́гу, но не прочита́л её.
corpus.en: I was reading the book but didn't finish it.
Latvia is a very green country.
In winter in Riga you need a hat.
How much money do you have?

corpus.ru: Я всегда́ покупа́ю фру́кты на ры́нке.
corpus.en: I always buy fruit at the market.
Everything at the market is cheap.
Do you have a map of Riga?
This size is too small for me.
The ticket costs two hundred euros.
I want to buy a jacket.

corpus.ru: Я из Ли́вии, но сейча́с я живу́ в Ри́ге.
corpus.en: I'm from Libya, but now I live in Riga.

corpus.ru: У меня́ есть брат и сестра́.
corpus.en: I have a brother and a sister.

corpus.ru: Моя́ сестра́ ма́ленькая, ей пять лет.
corpus.en: My sister is little, she is five.

corpus.ru: Я чита́ю кни́ги и смотрю́ фи́льмы по-ру́сски.
corpus.en: I read books and watch films in Russian.

corpus.ru: Я ещё пло́хо понима́ю, но я учу́ ру́сский язы́к ка́ждый день.
corpus.en: I still understand poorly, but I learn Russian every day.
One coffee and some water, please.
A big or a small coffee?
Small, please. How much is it?

corpus.ru: Ко́фе сто́ит три е́вро, вода́ — два е́вро.
corpus.en: The coffee is three euros, the water two euros.
Thank you! Have a nice day!
Barsik is small but very smart.

corpus.ru: Ка́ждое у́тро он смо́трит в окно́.
corpus.en: Every morning he looks out of the window.

corpus.ru: Он ви́дит большо́й го́род, маши́ны и люде́й.
corpus.en: He sees the big city, cars and people.
In the daytime Barsik sleeps on the books.

corpus.ru: Ба́рсик не уме́ет чита́ть, но он всё понима́ет.
corpus.en: Barsik can't read, but he understands everything.
Hi! Are you a new student?

corpus.ru: Да. Меня́ зову́т Али́. А тебя́?
corpus.en: Yes. My name is Ali. And yours?
I'm Anna. Nice to meet you!
Me too. Are you from Riga?

corpus.ru: Да, я из Ри́ги. А ты отку́да?
corpus.en: Yes, I'm from Riga. And where are you from?
A little. I'm still learning Russian.

corpus.ru: Спаси́бо! Како́й у тебя́ но́мер телефо́на?
Два, три, пять, во́семь, ноль, оди́н, де́вять, де́вять.
corpus.en: Two, three, five, eight, zero, one, nine, nine.

corpus.ru: Нет, молока́ сейча́с нет. Есть вода́ и сок.
corpus.en: No, there's no milk right now. There's water and juice.

corpus.ru: Хлеб — оди́н е́вро, сок — два е́вро. Всего́ три е́вро.
corpus.en: Bread is one euro, juice two euros. Three euros in total.
Who is that in the photo?

corpus.ru: Э́то моя́ семья́. Вот мой па́па и моя́ ма́ма.
corpus.en: This is my family. Here are my dad and my mum.

corpus.ru: Э́то мой брат. Его́ зову́т Ома́р. Ему́ два́дцать три го́да.
corpus.en: That's my brother. His name is Omar. He is twenty-three.

corpus.ru: Э́то моя́ сестра́ Ле́йла. Ей пять лет.
corpus.en: That's my sister Leila. She is five.

corpus.ru: Кака́я краси́вая! У тебя́ больша́я семья́.
corpus.en: How pretty! You have a big family.

corpus.ru: Да. А у тебя́ есть бра́тья и́ли сёстры?
corpus.en: Yes. And do you have brothers or sisters?

corpus.ru: Нет, у меня́ нет ни бра́та, ни сестры́. Но у меня́ есть кот!
corpus.en: No, I have neither a brother nor a sister. But I have a cat!
Ha-ha, a cat is family too!
Ali, do you work or study?

corpus.ru: Я учу́сь. А ещё я рабо́таю в кафе́ в суббо́ту.
corpus.en: I study. And I also work in a café on Saturdays.

corpus.ru: Здо́рово! А что ты лю́бишь де́лать?
corpus.en: Cool! And what do you like doing?

corpus.ru: Я люблю́ игра́ть в волейбо́л и смотре́ть фи́льмы.
corpus.en: I like playing volleyball and watching films.

corpus.ru: Я то́же люблю́ волейбо́л! Но я пло́хо игра́ю.
corpus.en: I love volleyball too! But I play badly.
No problem. Do you want to play with us?

corpus.ru: Да, коне́чно! А где вы игра́ете?
corpus.en: Yes, of course! And where do you play?
In the park, near the university.

corpus.ru: Я не зна́ю, где э́то. Ты мо́жешь сказа́ть а́дрес?
corpus.en: I don't know where that is. Can you tell me the address?
Hi! What are you doing tomorrow?

corpus.ru: За́втра вто́рник… У́тром у меня́ уро́к, а днём я рабо́таю.
corpus.en: Tomorrow is Tuesday… In the morning I have a lesson, and in the afternoon I work.

corpus.ru: Ве́чером я свобо́дна. Ты хо́чешь встре́титься?
corpus.en: In the evening I'm free. Do you want to meet?

corpus.ru: Да. Дава́й в кафе́ в семь часо́в?
corpus.en: Yes. Let's meet at the café at seven?

corpus.ru: В семь я не могу́. Мо́жет быть, в во́семь?
corpus.en: I can't at seven. Maybe at eight?

corpus.ru: В кафе́ на у́лице Бри́вибас. Э́то бли́зко от метро́.
corpus.en: At the café on Brīvības Street. It's close to the metro.
Great! What time is it now?

corpus.ru: Сейча́с пять мину́т пе́рвого. Мне пора́! До за́втра!
corpus.en: It's five past twelve. I have to go! See you tomorrow!
Good evening! Here is the menu.

corpus.ru: Спаси́бо. Скажи́те, пожа́луйста, мя́со у вас халя́льное?
corpus.en: Thank you. Tell me please, is your meat halal?

corpus.ru: Извини́те, нет. Но у нас есть о́чень вку́сная ры́ба.
corpus.en: Sorry, no. But we have very tasty fish.

corpus.ru: Хорошо́. Тогда́ я бу́ду ры́бу с ри́сом.
corpus.en: OK. Then I'll have the fish with rice.

corpus.ru: А суп? Сего́дня у нас овощно́й суп.
corpus.en: And soup? Today we have vegetable soup.

corpus.ru: Чай без са́хара. И мо́жно стака́н воды́?
corpus.en: Tea without sugar. And can I have a glass of water?
It was delicious! The bill, please.

corpus.ru: Извини́те, вы не зна́ете, где здесь апте́ка?
corpus.en: Excuse me, do you know where there's a pharmacy here?
A pharmacy? Yes, I know. It's not far.
Straight and to the right. And then?

corpus.ru: Пото́м вы уви́дите банк. Апте́ка сле́ва от ба́нка.
corpus.en: Then you'll see a bank. The pharmacy is to the left of the bank.

corpus.ru: А э́то далеко́? Мо́жно дойти́ пешко́м?
corpus.en: And is it far? Can I walk there?
Yes, of course. Five minutes on foot.

corpus.ru: Извини́те, како́й авто́бус идёт в центр?
corpus.en: Excuse me, which bus goes to the centre?
The tram goes there too, but slowly.
Where can I buy a ticket?
On the bus or in the app.

corpus.ru: Спаси́бо! А вы то́же е́дете в центр?
corpus.en: Thanks! Are you going to the centre too?

corpus.ru: Нет, я е́ду домо́й. Смотри́те, ваш авто́бус!
corpus.en: No, I'm going home. Look, your bus!
Hi Ali! How was your weekend?

corpus.ru: Хорошо́! В суббо́ту я рабо́тал, а в воскресе́нье мы игра́ли в волейбо́л.
corpus.en: Good! On Saturday I worked, and on Sunday we played volleyball.

corpus.ru: Нет, мы проигра́ли. Но бы́ло ве́село. А ты что де́лала?
corpus.en: No, we lost. But it was fun. And what did you do?

corpus.ru: Я была́ у ба́бушки. Мы гото́вили и смотре́ли ста́рые фотогра́фии.
corpus.en: I was at my grandma's. We cooked and looked at old photos.

corpus.ru: Как ми́ло! А ты прочита́ла кни́гу, кото́рую я тебе́ дал?
corpus.en: How nice! And did you finish the book I gave you?

corpus.ru: Ещё нет. Я чита́ла её вчера́ ве́чером, но усну́ла!
corpus.en: Not yet. I was reading it last night, but I fell asleep!
Ha-ha! Never mind, you'll still finish it.
Anna, is it very cold outside?

corpus.ru: Да, ми́нус де́сять! Наде́нь тёплую ку́ртку.
corpus.en: Yes, minus ten! Put on a warm jacket.

corpus.ru: У меня́ то́лько си́няя ку́ртка. Она́ не о́чень тёплая.
corpus.en: I only have a blue jacket. It's not very warm.

corpus.ru: Тогда́ ну́жно купи́ть зи́мнюю. И ша́пку!
corpus.en: Then you need to buy a winter one. And a hat!

corpus.ru: Я никогда́ не носи́л ша́пку. В Ли́вии жа́рко.
corpus.en: I've never worn a hat. It's hot in Libya.

corpus.ru: Здесь без ша́пки нельзя́! Хо́чешь, пойдём в магази́н вме́сте?
corpus.en: Here you can't go without a hat! Want to go to the shop together?

corpus.ru: Да, коне́чно. Каки́е цвета́ сейча́с в мо́де?
corpus.en: Yes, of course. Which colours are in fashion now?

corpus.ru: Чёрный всегда́ в мо́де. Но тебе́ пойдёт зелёный!
corpus.en: Black is always in fashion. But green will suit you!

corpus.ru: Да, пожа́луйста. Я ищу́ зи́мнюю ку́ртку.
corpus.en: Yes, please. I'm looking for a winter jacket.

corpus.ru: Вот, посмотри́те. Э́та зелёная о́чень тёплая.
corpus.en: Here, have a look. This green one is very warm.
Nice! How much does it cost?

corpus.ru: Сто два́дцать е́вро, но сего́дня ски́дка два́дцать проце́нтов.
corpus.en: A hundred and twenty euros, but today there's twenty percent off.

corpus.ru: Зна́чит, девяно́сто шесть. Хорошо́, я её возьму́!
corpus.en: So ninety-six. OK, I'll take it!
Great! By card or in cash?
By card. And can I have the receipt, please?
Can I have the book, please?
There are a lot of people here.
In the daytime I'm at university.
Excuse me, do you speak English?

corpus.ru: У меня́ нет ни ко́фе, ни ча́я.
corpus.en: I have neither coffee nor tea.
My number is two, zero, five.
My name is Anna. — Nice to meet you!
Where's the window? — There it is.
I didn't get it. Please repeat.
She read the letter (to the end).
Are you free tonight? (to a man)
Where is a halal shop here?
How do I get to the metro on foot?
The market is open in the morning.
The metro is on the right.
The ticket is in the app.
How do I get to the metro?
Does this bus go to the centre?
At the weekend I'm at home.
I've lived in Riga for a long time.
In summer it's hot in Libya.

corpus.ru: Год наза́д я был в Ли́вии.
corpus.en: A year ago I was in Libya.

corpus.ru: Я никогда́ не был в Москве́.

corpus.en: I'll call you in the evening.
I used to not understand Russian.
The plane to Libya is at seven.
I don't want to go there.
